change.source: finding 4 (taking the kept envelopes of a reconnect by the inbox acted for leaves every case green): round 2 (0723ed8): bridge_own_key::the_agents_kept_envelopes_are_posted_again_once_by_its_next_command_under_for holds what the client does: both envelopes are from the agent, so its next command after a new start posts both again once, with the header when that command runs under --for, and the command after it posts none; the mutant is red in it. The outbox does not record under which --for an envelope was posted and this story does not add that: the service answers a post with the header as one without it (docs/design/service.md, the row of post), so both reach the same inbox
